entries.speaker: Fusion Alarm
entries.en: [clr 2]A Fusion Alarm may occur after winning a battle[clr 27] in[n]the Metaverse. During an alarm the Velvet Room[n]will turn red and the execution results will differ.

entries.speaker: Fusion Alarm
entries.en: Personas will gain [clr 2]more stat values[clr 27], [clr 2]different[n]skills[clr 27], and [clr 2]max skill inheritance slots[clr 27]. Using[n]Guillotine, Electric Chair, or [clr 2]the same execution[n]method multiple times will cause an accident[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Fusion Alarm
entries.en: An accident may occur if you use the Persona that[n]was made during the alarm as the material. But,[n]there is a chance that the stat values might increase[n]even more.

entries.speaker: Fusion Alarm
entries.en: When an accident occurs you will be told to leave.[n]The alarm will also end if you leave after a fusion.[n]You can [clr 2]speak to the Wardens to stop the alarm[n]without fusing[clr 27].
